data.name: PooDaddy
data.detailed_description:
Dr. Doo has snapped.

His latest experiment has turned ordinary bathrooms into war zones crawling with angry Whitey Tighties, psychotic plungers, rogue rubber duckies, and every filthy bathroom nightmare imaginable. Every flush makes his army stronger, and his next stop is every bathroom on Earth.

Unfortunately for him...

There's one guy crazy enough to fight back.

Step into the boots of PooDaddy, an unlikely hero armed with an endless supply of poop, questionable life choices, and absolutely zero fear. Battle your way through impossible enemy hordes, rescue Momma Poo, unlock outrageous new characters, and send Dr. Doo's army straight back down the drain where it belongs.

PooDaddy is a fast paced action roguelite that combines addictive survivor style gameplay with over the top cartoon comedy. Every run throws you into escalating chaos where thousands of enemies swarm the screen, ridiculous bosses stand in your way, and every upgrade pushes your build closer to becoming completely unstoppable.

Whether you're melting entire armies with overpowered builds, surviving random bathroom disasters, or laughing at the absurd world around you, every run feels bigger, crazier, and more rewarding than the last.

Features

• Fast paced survivor style gameplay that is easy to learn and impossible to put down.

• Battle through handcrafted levels beginning with the Bathroom Blitz and expanding into increasingly ridiculous locations.

• Unlock a growing roster of unique playable characters, each with their own starting weapon and personality.

• Defeat unforgettable bosses including monstrous plungers, evil rubber duckies, and the twisted creations of Dr. Doo.

• Spend coins in the Poo Lab to permanently upgrade your entire account and become stronger every run.

• Experience random world events that completely change the battlefield from eerie fog to power outages and other unexpected surprises.

• Play solo or team up with friends in online cooperative multiplayer.

• Collect mountains of coins, uncover secrets, chase high scores, and become the legendary PooDaddy.

A World That Doesn't Take Itself Seriously

Everything in PooDaddy is built around one goal.

Making you laugh while giving you that "just one more run" feeling.

Enemies wobble and throw tantrums, explosions fill the screen, and every victory somehow becomes even more ridiculous than the last. Beneath all the toilet humor is a polished action game with satisfying progression, responsive controls, and constant dopamine fueled chaos.

So grab your courage.

Ignore the smell.

And save the bathroom.

The world is counting on you.

data.short_description: PooDaddy is a fast paced auto battler where you build ridiculously overpowered attacks. PooDaddy combines ridiculous cartoon humor, a story driven world and unpredictable events that can supercharge your run or turn the entire level against you. Every run becomes chaotic and different.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 630 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 720p at 30 FPS on Low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p at 60 FPS
